name: is_link
title: Functions to test for file types

origin.description: Functions to test for file types
origin.usage:
is_file(path, follow = TRUE)

is_dir(path, follow = TRUE)

is_link(path)

is_file_empty(path, follow = TRUE)

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: A character vector of one or more paths.

arguments.name: follow
arguments.text:
If TRUE, symbolic links will be followed (recursively) and
the results will be that of the final file rather than the link.

origin.details: Functions to test for file types
origin.value:
A named logical vector, where the names give the paths. If the given
object does not exist, NA is returned.
origin.example:
.old_wd <- setwd(tempdir())
dir_create("d")

file_create("d/file.txt")
dir_create("d/dir")
link_create(path(path_abs("d"), "file.txt"), "d/link")

paths <- dir_ls("d")
is_file(paths)
is_dir(paths)
is_link(paths)

# Cleanup
dir_delete("d")
setwd(.old_wd)
